title: Aaiwa Service Based Application
description: Backend-led service platform scaled from 30,000 to 40,000+ active users. Led REST API optimization achieving ~40% faster response times, refactored a legacy codebase, and eliminated critical performance bottlenecks. Built a fully configurable Perfex CRM admin panel featuring spin-wheel campaigns (OneSignal), slot-based coupon systems, and template-level homepage control — cutting ops team workload by ~50%.

title: Hospital & Doctor Consultation Platform
description: Scalable MERN healthcare system handling 5,000+ monthly appointments. Built structured doctor–patient consultation flows, appointment scheduling with conflict resolution, and role-based admin workflows. Backend APIs were performance-tuned to handle concurrent booking loads without degradation.

title: Joint Fn – Joint Finance App
description: AI vibe-coded gamified finance tracker built with Expo and expo-sqlite. Features XP-based expense tracking where spending habits earn or lose experience points, forecasting logic to predict monthly burn rate, and a Google Stitch-designed UI. Scaffolded with Replit and powered by Gemini for AI-assisted code generation — a personal experiment in building fast with AI tools.

title: Multimedia Mobile Application
description: Cross-platform React Native content app maintained for 12+ months with 99.5% crash-free sessions across iOS and Android. Optimized file handling for large media assets, integrated Stripe subscription flows, and tuned rendering performance for smooth playback on mid-range devices.

title: Philippines Government Service Mobile App
description: Public-facing government service mobile app serving 2,000+ citizens across the Philippines. Built with Cordova for broad device compatibility, with strong focus on accessibility standards, offline reliability, and secure REST API integration for sensitive public service data delivery.

title: Office Party Fun Game Platform
description: Interactive MERN web platform built for corporate team events. Hosts multiple mini-games with real-time score tracking, live leaderboards, and simultaneous multi-team participation. Designed for high engagement in short bursts — zero setup required for event hosts.

title: Mentoring Management System
description: Migrated a legacy PHP academic mentoring system to full MERN stack. Achieved ~60% improvement in page load speed through RESTful API restructuring, database query optimization, and a fully responsive React.js frontend. Improved mentor–student session tracking and reporting workflows.

title: Sling – Bulk Recharge Platform
description: Three-domain enterprise platform enabling companies to bulk-upload employee mobile numbers via CSV and process large-scale recharges efficiently. Contributed as Frontend Developer and Backend Support Engineer — built the UI, integrated REST APIs, and ensured reliable status reporting across all three domains.

title: Tippen Ads Publishing Platform
description: Instagram-style vertical video feed for publishing short-form ad and training content internally. Supports smooth video playback, content upload and management, and structured delivery via REST API. Built for office use — lightweight, fast, and distraction-free.
